landing.manifesto.title: They teach you not to shine. You — burn instead.
landing.manifesto.body: Social media taught us to scroll through time; Athanor teaches us to seize it. No followers to hoard, no vanity metrics: only real people, moments that matter, projects that come to life. And one question at the heart of every profile: "what is your dream?".

landing.aura.quote: On Athanor you do not count followers. You light your Aura.
landing.aura.body: Aura is evolutionary reputation: a living value that grows only through real, verifiable actions. No one can buy or fake it; it fades with inactivity and is never inherited — it is kept burning.
landing.sogno.body: Every profile shows what no other platform asks for: the owner's dream. Not a job title, but a direction. Beside it sits a button — "Make this dream happen" — and the dream stops being private: it becomes a collective project.
landing.daivita.quote: Here, dreams aren't told. They come true.
landing.daivita.body: Once a year, the whole community lights a single fire: one dream chosen by everyone and made real by everyone. You contribute from €1, and 90% goes to the dream. Thousands of people, one dream made real — and next time it could be you.

landing.meta.description: Athanor is the community where reputation is earned through action, not followers. Real people, moments that matter, projects that come to life. Coming soon to iOS and Android.
landing.nome.quote: Alone, time is a circle. Together, it is the flame that rises between two circles.
landing.nome.body: Athanor is the alchemist's furnace: the vessel that keeps the fire, where base matter transmutes into gold. The infinite scroll is a circle spinning alone — motion without progress. But when two circles meet, a mandorla forms, a crucible: the instant two people truly meet. And from that meeting, gold is born.
landing.problem.title: The more connected we are, the lonelier we feel.
landing.problem.follower: Followers ≠ trust — a high number says nothing about a person's worth.
landing.problem.scroll: Infinite scroll — designed to retain you, not to grow you.
landing.problem.networking: Shallow networking — contacts that never become collaborations.
landing.problem.tools: Fragmented tools — one app to talk, another to work, another for events.
landing.problem.growth: No growth — no platform measures what truly counts: who you are becoming.
landing.problem.target: Too professional for Instagram, too human for LinkedIn. Athanor is the space that was missing.

store.promo: Your reputation is earned, never bought.
store.description: Athanor is the community where what you actually do is what counts. No followers, no vanity metrics: a reputation — your Aura — you grow only through real action. Write your dream, break it into small steps, and let the right people make it happen. Encounters that matter, real projects, live events. Somewhere, someone is the right moment for your dream.

fund.progress.zeroAura: Telling the story earns no Aura. No step of the fund does.

fund.disclose.title: Before you contribute
fund.disclose.lead: Sixteen things to know, in six points. Read them calmly: then you decide.
fund.disclose.where.title: Where the money goes
fund.disclose.where.pool: Your contribution joins the shared fund of the current cycle.
fund.disclose.where.anyAmount: You take part from €1, with no upper limit.
fund.disclose.where.fees: Payment processing costs are deducted, unless you choose the optional coverage.
fund.disclose.notPurchase.title: It's not a purchase
fund.disclose.notPurchase.noShare: You buy no share of the winning project.
fund.disclose.notPurchase.noAdvantage: Contributing guarantees nothing for your own dream.
fund.disclose.notPurchase.voteDecides: The community's vote decides which dream gets funded.
fund.disclose.noReturn.title: There is no return
fund.disclose.noReturn.othersDream: Your contribution may make another person's dream real.
fund.disclose.noReturn.notReturned: The money is not returned automatically.
fund.disclose.noReturn.nextDream: While a dream is in realization, a new contribution funds the next dream, not that one.
fund.disclose.ifFails.title: If the cycle doesn't succeed
fund.disclose.ifFails.belowFloor: If the collection stays below the minimum floor, the cycle is voided and the money stays in the fund, for the next cycle.
fund.disclose.ifFails.belowQuorum: If the vote doesn't reach quorum, the cycle is voided and the money stays in the fund, for the next cycle.
fund.disclose.ifFails.winnerDeclines: If the winner steps back because the dream can't be delivered, the cycle is voided and the money stays in the fund, for the next cycle.
fund.disclose.ifFails.shortBudget: If the fund closes below the budget, the dream is resized to the money that truly exists.
fund.disclose.retains.title: What Athanor retains
fund.disclose.retains.percent: Athanor retains {percent}% this cycle. The percentage is declared in advance and does not change.
fund.disclose.retains.equity: Any stake in the project is declared in advance and executed through proper legal instruments.
fund.disclose.compliance.title: Regulatory compliance
fund.disclose.compliance.law: Everything happens in accordance with applicable law.
fund.disclose.coverage.label: I'll add €{fee} to cover the processing costs.
fund.disclose.coverage.optional: You can leave this box empty: your contribution counts just the same.
fund.disclose.coverage.notReturned: The coverage pays the payment network; it doesn't enter the fund. If your contribution is ever refunded, the coverage doesn't come back.
